name: Movistar
verdict: Movistar is Telefónica's commercial brand for Spain and Hispanic America; Telefónica has no controlling shareholder, and its significant holders include SEPI (10.00%) and Saudi Arabia's PIF (9.97% via Green Bridge/stc, with a board seat).
note: Spanish telecoms brand of Telefónica (listed). Title sponsor of the men's UCI WorldTeam and the women's UCI Women's WorldTeam. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Proposal: concern — Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund held 9.97% of Telefónica at 31 December 2025 (telefonica-significant-shareholders-2025) and stc's CEO sits on Telefónica's board (telefonica-stc-board-seat); Saudi Arabia's record of 345 executions in 2024 is documented in saudi-executions-2024.
